test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: gk
question: As of 2023, when was the last fundamental duty added to Article 51 A?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2002.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The last Fundamental Duty was added to Article 51A of the Indian Constitution by the** 86th Constitutional Amendment Act in 2002.**
 
• This amendment inserted** Clause (k),** which states: "It shall be the duty of every parent or guardian to provide opportunities for education to their child or ward between the ages of six and fourteen years."
 
• This duty was added to complement the** Right to Education**, which became a fundamental right under** Article 21A **through the same amendment, ensuring free and compulsory education for children in this age group.
 
• It **strengthens the Directive Principles of State Policy** by creating a legal obligation for parents to ensure their children receive an education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 

 Article Number
 Fundamental Duty
 
 
 
 

 Article 51A (a)
 To abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals and institutions, the National Flag, and the National Anthem.
 
 

 Article 51A (b)
 To cherish and follow the noble ideals that inspired the national struggle for freedom.
 
 

 Article 51A (c)
 To uphold and protect the sovereignty, unity, and integrity of India.
 
 

 Article 51A (d)
 To defend the country and render national service when called upon to do so.
 
 

 Article 51A (e)
 To promote harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst all the people of India, transcending religious, linguistic, and regional or sectional diversities.
 
 

 Article 51A (f)
 To value and preserve the rich heritage of the country's composite culture.
 
 

 Article 51A (g)
 To protect and improve the natural environment including forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife, and to have compassion for living creatures.
 
 

 Article 51A (h)
 To develop scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
 
 

 Article 51A (i)
 To safeguard public property and to abjure violence.
 
 

 Article 51A (j)
 To strive towards excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity so that the nation constantly rises to higher levels of endeavor and achievement.
 
 

 Article 51A (k)
 To provide opportunities for education to children between the ages of 6 and 14 years (for parents/guardians).
